entity: Kansas State Park and Resources Authority
summary: The Kansas State Park and Resources Authority reviewed the draft environmental statement on the implementation of Executive Order 11644 regarding off-road vehicles on public lands. They found the statement to be well presented and not in conflict with any policies administered by their agency, indicating no objection to the proposal.

statement.text:
Inis is to advise that we have reviewed the above referred to
clearinghouse project, no. 1277ES, submitted by the Bureau of Outdoor
Recreation, U. S. Department of Interior, pertaining to a draft envir-
onmental statement on the implementation of Executive Order 11644Use
of Off-Road Vehicles on the Public Lands. We find the statement to be
well presented and not conflicting with any policies presently admin-
istered by the Kansas State Park and Resources Authority.
Verne Hart by Gary L. Haller
